Results.ReviewText: After owning a dozen or more grills in my lifetime (46 yr) mostly CB brand I finally broke down and bought a Weber that I have been wanting for ages. I went w a very entry level model but I think anything is entry w this Brand. So far I have done about 4 coos including break-in cook of old bacon just to see it sizzle and test the features of the burning zones. While at first I had to adjust to a grill that warms vapor shields vs. a flame that just burns everything w little heat control. So far burgers and sausage turned out restaurant quality for y family. So glad to have the BS on the market and be back on the flames cooking healthy eats w a high quality tool to do so. Probably the first grill I went more basic vs bells and whistles that I never use anyways ie: side burner.
Results.Title: Top in Class for the value

Results.ReviewText:
Dear Weber


I am a long time customer. I have owed several models of your grills over the years.
Enjoyed your quality and customer service until today.

I purchased a new Spirit 325 with boost and am really not happy with quality. Thin materials, cheap plastic feet and wheels.
No caster wheels with locks. Also the lack of an enclosed grill cabinet. Why would you leave the back open?
What's the point of having a door with an open back? Critters will love their new home...

My grill came missing the the match stick holder for lighting the grill manually. 
Please see setup manual page 24 and user manual page 8.

I spoke with customer service and was told although this is refencened in the manual 
it does not come included with my model grill. SERIOUSLY.... REALLY.....
How am I to SAFETY light the grill if the ignitor goes bad?

Come on Weber DO BETTER!!!
Results.Title: Let down

Results.ReviewText: I like the improvement from my last Spirit grill. The soft close with out a bang. The foldable side selves which are also covered rather than just metal this also keeps the area from being hot. I had melted plastic on the previous side shelves. Also, the igniters on all three burners works!
Results.Title: New versus old Spirit grill.

Results.ReviewText:
We are long time Weber Grill owners and supporters.  We have owned a Weber Grill of one model or another for the last 40 years.  This new Grill (E325) is pretty good, however there has been noticeable pullback in the quality of materials used in making the product.  The folding side tables are not stainless steel, the lid side castings and metal center are lighter weight materials (not as robust), the wheels are cheap plastic & located on one side of the grill rather than the casters on all four corners and The Rear Of The Compartment (where propane tank is held underneath) Has An Open Back.  The open back allows animals to enter to get to the grease catcher or seek shelter and build nests.  The previous models we owned all had enclosed areas underneath to keep the critters out.
I like the "Sear Zone" and it works pretty well.  The starting & temperature setting procedure is a little "non-intuitive".  I understand it, but if I ask someone else who does not own one of these grills to start and set the temperature it is likely not going to get done properly or at all.  I also miss the propane tank holder that let me know when the tank was getting near empty (Lite).  The Temperature guage is always fogged up inside the glass (my previous grill that lasted 10 years did not do that?)
I guess I will need to wait to see how the grill holds up over time.  I do like the grill and how it cooks the things I need it to. I do still feel the grill appears a "good value" if it holds up over time (versus buying 2 or 3 cheaper grills over the same time period).  I don't like to feed the local landfill with rusted out grill remnants.  
So far, all is good with the new Weber.
Results.Title: Things change, but for the better?  Time will tell

Results.ReviewText: It was bought as a Christmas present back in maybe August or September. It was assembled in January and has only worked correctly a couple of times. I called the service line told him what I thought we had as a problem and was basically given a list of things to do that I had already done. I explained that to them I got no satisfaction. When lighting the grill it will only stay lit on a very low flame and if you turn more than one burner on the flame goes out. I have worked around propane in the past and have came to the conclusion that the regulator is not working correctly. I now have a grill setting in my garage is not usable and I need to go online and purchase a regulator for a grill under warranty that the people at Weber do not want to stand behind. I am extremely sad that I purchased this and really wish I would’ve purchased another brand.
Results.Title: Grill does not work
